name: 1st Birthday
metaDescription: Planning a 1st birthday party in Singapore? OurKampung styles and runs stress-free first-birthday celebrations — décor, cake, smash-cake moment and full coordination.
intro: A first birthday is really a celebration for the whole family — and the last thing new parents need is more to organise. We take the entire day off your hands: a beautifully styled setup, a cake worth photographing, and a calm, well-run celebration where you get to actually enjoy the milestone. One concierge, every detail, start to finish.
highlights: A softly styled backdrop and balloon setup built around your theme
A first-birthday cake, plus an optional smash-cake moment for the photos
A relaxed run-of-show so feeds, naps and cake-cutting all fit
Delivery, setup and teardown handled — you just turn up

faqs.q: How much does a 1st birthday party cost in Singapore?
faqs.a: It depends on guest numbers, venue and how styled you'd like it. Décor-only setups start from a few hundred dollars and scale up with cake, catering and entertainment. Tell us your budget and we'll build a package to match.

faqs.q: Can you keep it small and low-key for a first birthday?
faqs.a: Absolutely — many first birthdays are intimate family gatherings at home or a condo function room. We scale the styling to suit and keep the day calm for your little one.

faqs.q: Do you provide the cake and a smash cake?
faqs.a: Yes. We arrange the main cake and, if you'd like, a separate smash cake for that classic first-birthday photo moment.

name: Full Month
h1: Full month celebrations, warm and beautifully done.
metaDescription: Planning a full month celebration in Singapore? OurKampung styles elegant baby full-month parties — décor, catering, guest gifts and complete coordination.
intro: The full-month celebration is a treasured Singaporean tradition — a first gathering to introduce your baby to family and friends. We style it with a soft, elegant touch and coordinate the details that matter, from the welcome table to the guest gifts, so you can be present with your loved ones rather than running the show.
highlights: A gentle, elegant setup in tones that suit your baby and venue
Coordination of catering and a celebratory cake or dessert table
Help arranging traditional guest gifts and red-egg touches if you'd like
Full delivery, setup and teardown, at home or a function room

faqs.q: Can you include traditional full-month elements?
faqs.a: Yes — we can weave in the customary touches such as guest gift boxes and red-egg-and-ginger elements alongside a modern, tasteful setup. Tell us which traditions matter to your family.

faqs.q: Do you cater for full-month gatherings at home?
faqs.a: We do. Homes and condo function rooms are perfect for full-month celebrations, and we handle delivery, setup and clearing so the space is left as we found it.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.a: Two to three weeks gives us the most flexibility, but we can often help on shorter notice — message us with your date and we'll do our best.

name: 100 Days
metaDescription: Celebrating your baby's 100 days in Singapore? OurKampung styles warm, elegant 100-day celebrations with décor, dessert tables and full coordination.
intro: Marking your baby's hundredth day is a lovely, gentle milestone — often a smaller, more intimate affair than the full month. We give it a soft, refined setup and a beautiful dessert or cake moment, and we take care of the logistics so the gathering feels calm and joyful for everyone, especially you.
highlights: A soft, photogenic setup scaled for an intimate gathering
A dessert table or celebration cake as the centrepiece
Coordination of light catering and guest touches
Delivery, setup and teardown fully handled

faqs.q: Is a 100 days celebration usually big or small?
faqs.a: Most are intimate family gatherings, though some families combine it with a larger celebration. We style it to whatever scale feels right for you.

faqs.q: Can you match a specific colour scheme or theme?
faqs.a: Of course — we'll tailor the palette and details to your taste, whether that's soft neutrals, gentle pastels or a particular motif.
At home, a condo function room, or a restaurant private room. We'll advise on the best setup for your chosen space anywhere in Singapore.

name: Baby Shower
metaDescription: Planning a baby shower in Singapore? OurKampung styles graceful, relaxed baby showers with décor, grazing tables, games and full coordination.
intro: A baby shower should feel like a lovely afternoon with the people you love — not a project. We create a graceful, welcoming setup, a beautiful grazing or dessert table, and a few gentle activities, then handle every logistic behind the scenes. You get to sit back, be celebrated, and enjoy the moment before baby arrives.
highlights: A soft, elegant setup with a styled photo corner
A grazing table, dessert spread or afternoon-tea styling
A few tasteful games and keepsake touches if you'd like them
Full setup and teardown at home, a function room or a café

faqs.q: Do you organise baby shower games and activities?
faqs.a: We can include as many or as few as you like — from a keepsake wish card station to light, tasteful games. Just tell us the vibe you're after.

faqs.q: Can you do a gender-neutral setup?
faqs.a: Yes, gender-neutral palettes are lovely and popular. We'll style it in warm neutrals or your chosen colours.

faqs.q: Can the shower be a surprise?
faqs.a: We're happy to coordinate discreetly with the host so the guest of honour is genuinely surprised. Just let us know the plan.

name: Gender Reveal
metaDescription: Planning a gender reveal party in Singapore? OurKampung styles fun, tasteful gender reveals with a big reveal moment, décor and full coordination.
intro: A gender reveal is all about one joyful moment — and we make sure it lands beautifully. We style a fresh, photogenic setup, coordinate the reveal itself (kept a secret from you, if you like), and handle the details so the surprise goes off without a hitch and the photos are wonderful.
highlights: A bright, photogenic setup ready for the big moment
A coordinated reveal — cake, balloon, or another tasteful option
The secret kept safe between us and your helper
Delivery, setup and teardown all taken care of

faqs.q: How can you keep the reveal a surprise from us?
faqs.a: We coordinate directly with your clinic or a trusted helper so neither parent sees the result — only the reveal moment does the telling.

faqs.q: What reveal options do you offer?
faqs.a: Popular choices include a cut-to-reveal cake, a colour-filled balloon, or a confetti moment. We'll suggest what suits your space and guest list.

faqs.q: Can we combine it with a baby shower?
faqs.a: Definitely — many families do both in one gathering. We'll plan a flow that fits both moments comfortably.
